title: UP Dakhil Kharij, Registration Online 2026
organization: Board of Revenue / Government of Uttar Pradesh
postName: Land Mutation (Dakhil Kharij) Online – Uttar Pradesh
vacancyDetails: Online mutation application and land registration related services in UP
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bhulekh.up.nic.in and UP revenue / IGRS portals
2. Check khatauni / land details
3. Apply for Dakhil-Kharij / mutation online or via tehsil e-services
4. Upload sale deed, photos and ID proofs
5. Track status and download mutation order
shortDescription: UP Dakhil Kharij (mutation) and registration online 2026 – land services via Bhulekh UP and revenue portals.
content:
In Uttar Pradesh, Dakhil Kharij updates ownership in revenue records after transfer of agricultural or other land.

Citizens can view land records on bhulekh.up.nic.in and apply for mutation through tehsil / online revenue services. Keep registered sale deed, identity proof and previous khatauni ready. Registration of deeds is handled via IGRS UP portals.
